We provide quality solutions for clients

PT Mas Automobil Sejahtera (PT MAS) which was established in 2022 in Pekanbaru is a supplier of large commercial vehicles with the Sinotruk brand, a supplier of Truck Mounted Cranes with the SUNHUNK brand and a supplier of Heavy Equipment with the SHANTUI brand. We provide commercial vehicles, Truck Mounted Cranes and heavy equipment that can be relied on for needs in the mining, forestry, construction, logistics and other industrial sectors.




PT Mas Automobil Sejahtera (PT MAS) is fully committed and prioritizes the satisfaction of our customers in the relationship. By striving to always meet all customer needs, provide solutions, and provide sales services and ensure the availability of spare parts with the best quality. We believe this commitment will make PT Mas Automobil Sejahtera able to compete in the national commercial vehicle and heavy equipment industry. We are also always open to criticism and suggestions, so that we can continue to improve our services to our customers.
